comment_corrections: /** Native GT packet forwarding. No buffers, energy conversion, absolute-value conversion or chunk loads. */
/** Forwards signed GT energy queries and external FE; subclasses own target resolution. */

readability.limit: Whitespace, listed method-local/lambda/event names and one source-backed comment correction. No gameplay edits.

finite_source_witnesses.kind: Finite source-branch and declared route analysis, no Java target execution, capability or world fixture.

routes.limit: Opposing front/secondary profiles and six queries. Not full wrench/placement validation or all selectable secondary profiles.

finite_source_witnesses.installation_chain: Own getCover excludes fallback; both default and injected componentItems/componentFluids then request null side, but relay exposes requires nonnull side. No relay-specific component accessor override.
finite_source_witnesses.installation_limit: Built-in current source path without third-party capability injection; loaded healthy target. Null-side lookup is not accepted as a legitimate replacement for original cover placement.

restored_cover_permissions.condition: Restored native gt_cover_n state, loaded willing target inventory/tank; ordinary30000/30001, no shutter. Not a normal survival installation witness.
Restored native gt_cover_n state, loaded willing target inventory/tank; ordinary30000/30001, no shutter. Not a normal survival installation witness.

active_components.case: Conveyor or pump restored by native gt_cover_n load on ordinary30000/30001, loaded endpoints and due source phase. Normal installation is blocked (275).
active_components.original_chain: Base06 finalonTick callsCoverData.tickPre; Conveyor/Pump have server/clock/stop/handler gates and transfer calls.
active_components.current_chain: Native load restores covers without canAttach, then source ticker onlytickSignals -> panels.beforeTick/afterTick; tickAttachments onlydrain/air_vent; fallbackuses=false because the relay overridesgetCover.
active_components.limit: A reached callback is not an actual moved-stack/litre measurement. Drain/air-vent and panel callbacks exist; not all cover ticks are absent.

finite_source_witnesses.signed_energy: Typed GT query/injection methods forward size/amount/execute without abs; actual external FE has separate native capability wrapper. Existing loaded/removed/visit guards remain.
